text: For the postmortem: what time did I first report the kiosks offline on 3 Aug, and what was the guard doing in the meantime?
reply_text:
Gideon, in #inc-vtg-hartford the first report is your 10:42 AM message on 3 Aug. Nothing else in the channel describes the guard before 11:03, so the only record of the guard is your own line at 10:42: writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. At 11:03 Mateo reported kiosk 1 back and the guard checking in trailer 8836. Your 11:08 message says both lanes were working as of 11:07.

One thing to check before the postmortem: the SUP-5380 ticket log (Sev 1, opened 2026-08-03) has an entry at 08:12, "Rebot failed; drivers queueing." That is earlier than your 10:42 post. I can't tell from here who filed it or whether it was the same outage, so the timeline may need that ticket checked.

text: And mine: which ticket holds the status-page screenshot for Mateo's access problem?
reply_text: Ruth, Gideon's 11:08 AM message on 3 Aug says the status-page screenshot is attached to ticket INC-4821. I only have that message to go on. I haven't opened the ticket to confirm the attachment is there.
